scope: Two actual Google Live synthetic-input sessions using installed Node SDK1.50.1; no robotHTTP, tools, Pupper access, browser, microphone, camera, or production changes. One replica per condition.
conclusions: Both isolated sessions received remote code1008 with The operation was aborted after approximately150–151seconds from turnComplete, without priorGoAway.
Typed/no-audio/no-end case reproduces it: audioStreamEnd, PTT, robot tools, controller execution and application lifecycle are not necessary causes.
The two root-observed browser cases were approximately101seconds after visible reply; this is not established as a universal fixed100second limit.

Official Google docs inspected describe longer context/connection limits and resumption, but did not document this shorter idle interval. Do not relabel it a documentedtimeout or assume all1008reasons share this cause.

No providerinternal rootcause is proven. Model-specific behavior, account/service policy and network path remain possible. Node transport is not identical to Chrome; neither experiment measures long-session reliability.

usage.limitation: usageMetadata event presence was recorded but its token fields were not captured in the original bounded probe. Actual billed cost is unknown; audio duration is not a billing estimate. No further calls made to recover that metadata.

immediate_minimum: Keep documentedPTT audioStreamEnd unchanged and retain current automaticStop/actionpause on disconnect.
Show connection-ended state and explicitReconnect; do not imply the robot crashed or that a serveraccepted action was reversed.
Log metadata-only connection age,lastsend,lastoutput,lastturnComplete,GoAway timeLeft,pending tool count and closecode/reason. Never log keys, resumption handles or raw microphone data.
resumption_contract: Enable sessionResumption:{} only in a reviewed candidate; retain latest valid resumable/newHandle in memory with current connection generation and completion boundary.
On any close/GoAway, pause tools and microphone, invalidate queued audio/output/tool generations, and perform existingStop handling. Connection recovery is not command retry.

If a tool is pending, Stop outcome unknown, state identity changed, or latest stable resumable token is unavailable, discard continuation and offer a fresh explicitconnection. Do not use an older token to replay a possiblyexecuted action.

On explicitReconnect, pass same-modelhandle only from a stable,known checkpoint. Keep mutations paused across session creation/resumption; do not let its initial continuations or function calls resume motion.
Refresh current serverinstance/epoch and status. Require a new deliberate userturn before enabling new motion intent; never replay bufferedPCM, queuedHTTP requests or prior functioncalls.
Bound one resumeattempt then visible freshconnection fallback; no silencekeepalive, hiddenretryloop or automaticmotionrearm.
offline_acceptance_cases: expired/stale resumptiontoken fails visibly with no dispatch
close during pending mutation keeps tools paused andStop unresolved accurately
resumed provider emits old functioncall before newinput: reject locally
explicit newturn after settledStop/freshinstance can issue onlynewintent
proposal_not_implemented.scope_warning: Provider resumption preserves context, not application action correctness. Documentation says generating/pending-function-call states may be nonresumable and oldhandle can lose data; this proposal must be reviewed/tested before implementation.
